mapper.select: select r.fact_id,r.revision from public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r join public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_heads h on h.tenant_id=r.tenant_id and h.fact_id=r.fact_id join public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions retired on retired.tenant_id=h.tenant_id and retired.fact_id=h.fact_id and retired.revision=h.current_revision where r.tenant_id=#{tenant} and r.revision>1 and r.revision<h.current_revision and r.revision<>r.content_revision and retired.status='ARCHIVED' and retired.superseded_fact_id is not null and retired.valid_to_epoch_second is not null and retired.recorded_at<#{cutoff}::timestamptz and r.recorded_at<#{cutoff}::timestamptz and (r.fact_id,r.revision)>(#{afterFact},#{afterRevision}) order by r.fact_id,r.revision limit #{limit} for update of h,r skip locked
mapper.delete: delete from public.agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r using (values (#{r.factId}::text,#{r.revision}::bigint) ) as candidate(fact_id,revision) where r.tenant_id=#{tenant} and r.fact_id=candidate.fact_id and r.revision=candidate.revision and public.agent_runtime_memory_history_unprotected(r.tenant_id,r.fact_id,r.revision,#{cutoff}::timestamptz)
